hero.title: Hong Kong semiconductor equipment group

intro.title: Who we are
paragraphs: BETTER SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO., LIMITED (倍特爾科技集團有限公司) operates from Hong Kong.
We focus on procurement and sales of equipment for the nine main process areas, and provide de-installation, installation and cross-border shipping.
Beyond equipment, we also take on advanced process technology transfer and semiconductor talent training projects.
We combine artificial intelligence with advanced manufacturing equipment and deploy it in real use cases across every process area.
features: Wafer fabs and advanced packaging and test plants
Research institutes and university laboratory lines
Buyers and sellers in the used and refurbished equipment market
New line projects under construction or expansion

entries.term: Mission: make advanced process equipment easier to obtain, to run well and to keep running.
entries.desc: We combine equipment procurement, relocation, transfer and training into a single process, lowering the barrier and the time cost of bringing up a line.

entries.term: Vision: lead the integration of artificial intelligence and advanced manufacturing equipment.
entries.desc: Using frontier AI architectures as our benchmark, we keep bringing verifiable intelligence into every process area.

leadership.title: Company principal
paragraphs: The principal sets the overall business direction of the group. Equipment procurement and client engagement run through a single point of contact, so nothing is lost in handovers between departments.

card.title: Kerwin Su (蘇益宏)
card.text: Responsible for overall business direction, equipment procurement and client engagement.

entries.title: Expertise
entries.text: We read equipment through process practice. Selection and tuning start from your line targets, not from catalog specifications.

entries.title: Completeness
entries.text: From procurement to installation and from technology to people, responsibility is not split, so no gaps open at the interfaces.

entries.title: Foresight
entries.text: We benchmark against published, verifiable frontier AI architectures and keep our deployment methods current.
